properties.description: Arrival-delta and schedule-movement tests (crates/reflow2-core/tests/temporal.rs) — 13 cases: the commitment survives a snapshot of the item while AT_EPOCH stays excluded; un-scheduling, a modality rewrite and deleting a scheduled item are all refused while the plan is unrecorded, and recording the change first unblocks them; adding to a plan is free; the baseline is the FIRST snapshot across two replans; an untouched item is outstanding, not discontinued; a required miss is a violation and a required delivery is not; late work is reported apart from the baseline; a planned epoch says it is a forecast; a non-moment is refused.
properties.findings: MUTATION-CHECKED on all three of Anthony's calls.
properties.name: Arrival delta and schedule movement across replans
